description: Running :Lazy sync in the user's ~/.config/nvim (lazy.nvim) performed install+clean+UPDATE: it relocked every plugin to newer commits, and mason-lspconfig v2 (removed setup_handlers) broke the user's lspconfig.lua. Recovery: no git repo in the config dir, so the pre-sync pins were reconstructed from on-disk evidence — HEAD reflogs ('checkout: moving from X to Y') for detached-pin plugins and refs/heads/<branch> for branch-attached plugins (local branch refs are untouched by fetch+detached checkout) — validated each sha (exists + ancestor of origin tip). Hand-retyping shas from a transcript produced 4 wrong commit strings; never retype hashes, derive from git. Restored via :Lazy restore. Lesson: prefer :Lazy install (no update) when adding a plugin to a pinned setup; keep dotfiles in git.
resolution: restored from on-disk git forensics (HEAD reflogs + local branch refs); lock now evidence-based
